tagline: AI reading companion for web novels and fanfiction.
summary: A local-first browser extension that improves the readability of machine-translated web novels, summarises long chapters in place, and tracks a reading library across several sites. It works with Gemini, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a local Ollama model.
highlights: Bring your own provider: Gemini, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a local Ollama model that keeps every word on the machine.
Works across ranobes.top, fanfiction.net, Archive of Our Own and scribblehub.com rather than a single site.
Tracks novels in a shelf-aware library with reading status, characters, relationships, genres and tags.
Telemetry is opt-in, asked for on first Library open, and records anonymous event counts only — no chapter text, reading history, API keys or tokens.
